allResults.question: A pharmaceutical company needs an AI model to classify drug interaction reports with high accuracy. Data is highly domain-specific, regulatory restrictions prevent data from leaving a sovereign region, and response latency must be under 200ms. IT budget is moderate. Which model architecture decision is most appropriate?
allResults.domainName: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architecture (Practice Quiz)
allResults.explanation: Domain-specific + sovereign residency + low latency + moderate budget favor a customized SLM hosted in-region.

allResults.question: (Repeat scenario) Warehouse staff rarely leave the operational workspace view and need demand planning insights through Copilot. Which AI experience model best fits, and why?
allResults.domainName: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architecture (Practice Quiz)
allResults.explanation: Embedded AI surfaces insights in-workspace (duplicate of Q48 with reordered options).

allResults.question: [Case Study - CHG] You are designing the Claims Summarization Agent. The solution requires transformation of inconsistent data from Azure Data Lake, HIPAA-compliant audit logging at the data level, and integration with custom data pipelines. The team suggests Copilot Studio for faster delivery. Which is the best platform choice to accomplish all requirements?
allResults.domainName: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architecture (Practice Quiz)
allResults.explanation: Custom pipelines + data-level HIPAA audit logging + data transformation require Microsoft Foundry.

allResults.question: [Case Study - CHG] The CTO requests deployment of four AI agents within 90 days. CHG lacks an AI CoE, has no governance framework, and handles HIPAA-regulated patient data. You must recommend the first agent to deploy to demonstrate measurable business value while minimizing implementation and compliance risk. Which agent should you prioritize?
allResults.domainName: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architecture (Practice Quiz)
allResults.explanation: HR Policy Q&A uses existing M365 data with minimal compliance risk — best first agent to show value while minimizing risk.

allResults.question: An organization's AI CoE was established 18 months ago with a centralized model, approving every AI project and owning all delivery. Business units now complain about delays. The CoE has successfully standardized governance frameworks and published reusable AI templates that product teams have adopted. What is the most appropriate NEXT step for the CoE's operating model evolution?
allResults.domainName: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architecture (Practice Quiz)
allResults.explanation: Evolve from centralized to hybrid/advisory: product teams own delivery, CoE maintains standards and consults.

allResults.question: A large enterprise has 12 AI use case proposals submitted to the AI Center of Excellence. The CoE has limited capacity, and the executive sponsor wants to approve all 12 for simultaneous execution. According to Microsoft's AI CoE framework, what should the AI CoE do FIRST?
allResults.domainName: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architecture (Practice Quiz)
allResults.explanation: Evaluate and prioritize use cases by value, feasibility, risk, and readiness before execution.

allResults.question: Statement: "For a high-volume enterprise workflow automation scenario that requires dynamic AI-driven insights, developer extensibility, and automated suggestions, combining generative pages, agent feed, and code-first enhancements is a recommended architectural pattern."
allResults.domainName: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architecture (Practice Quiz)
allResults.explanation: Combining generative pages, agent feed, and code-first enhancements is a recommended pattern for this scenario.

allResults.question: A financial services firm needs an AI agent that executes multi-step loan approval workflows, integrates with three internal APIs, and enforces strict separation of duties between teams. Compliance requires full auditability of every agent action, and IT has strong developer expertise. Which platform architecture decision best satisfies all constraints?
allResults.domainName: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architecture (Practice Quiz)
allResults.explanation: Microsoft Foundry with role-scoped agents, explicit action boundaries, eval pipelines, and audit trails meets separation-of-duties and auditability.

allResults.question: A retail organization wants to give warehouse staff access to demand planning insights through Copilot. Staff rarely leave the operational workspace view. Two options are under discussion: a sidecar Copilot experience or an embedded AI approach. Which AI experience model best fits this scenario, and why?
allResults.domainName: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architecture (Practice Quiz)
allResults.explanation: Embedded AI surfaces insights within the operational workspace, reducing navigation overhead for staff who rarely leave that view.

allResults.question: A global pharmaceutical company needs a conversational AI agent to assist regulatory compliance officers. The process involves highly proprietary compound data, strict FDA-governed decision workflows, and internal IP that cannot be shared with any external vendor. The organization has a mature AI engineering team. Which AI development approach should the architect recommend?
allResults.domainName: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architecture (Practice Quiz)
allResults.explanation: Highly proprietary IP that cannot leave the org, strict regulatory workflows, and a mature AI team favor Build (fully custom).
